paras: At 7.42 the town went out. Not slowly, the way evening usually comes, but all at once, as if someone had pulled a plug from the sky. The traffic lights died mid-blink. Fridges fell silent. In the sudden dark, the high street stopped being a street and became a rumour: footsteps, a dog, someone laughing nervously behind a shop door.

variety of vocabulary and sentence types

questions.q: Proofread your timed piece using your error log; count and fix your errors.
questions.a: Errors found and corrected; a count recorded.

questions.q: Find two features in the model that show AO5 range.
questions.a: For example: 'died mid-blink' (precise verb); 'Then the candles began.' (short sentence).

questions.q: Core: in the portal response box, polish your weakest paragraph with the four AO5 moves. Starter: paste the paragraph, then improve it.
questions.a: A polished paragraph with precise verbs, a varied opening, a short sentence and no errors.

questions.q: Extend: rewrite your opening sentence for impact.
Stretch: cut ten unnecessary words from your piece.
Which edit adds the most AO5 range?
options: Replacing three plain verbs with precise ones and adding a short sentence
questions.a: A) Replacing three plain verbs with precise ones and adding a short sentence. Precision and sentence variety show range; extra adjectives often weaken writing.

questions.q: Answer the ponder in one sentence.
questions.a: Answers vary; usually fixing comma splices or upgrading verbs.
